action_description: Hero is on the button with 1000 chips. Blinds 10/20. Opponent raises to 100.
explanation: You have a strong draw with a gutshot and overcards, raising is optimal.

action_description: Hero is in the big blind with 500 chips. Blinds 10/20. Opponent bets 200 into a 400 pot.
explanation: You have 7-high with no draw. Folding is the only option.

action_description: Hero is UTG with 2000 chips. Blinds 25/50. You have pocket aces.
explanation: Pocket aces pre-flop should be raised for value.

action_description: Hero is in position with 1500 chips. Blinds 15/30. Opponent c-bets 100 into 150.
explanation: With a pocket pair and overcards on board, calling in position is standard.

action_description: Hero has an open-ended straight draw with two overcards. Pot is 300, opponent bets 150.
explanation: You have a strong draw with overcards. A semi-bluff raise applies maximum pressure.
